basis.cloud_cost_distribution: natural-log mean and sample SD of the six valid Sonnet 4.6 cloud-only calibration costs
basis.cloud_resolution_rates: Beta(1,1) posterior means for observed L1 2/2, L2 1/2, and L3 0/2 outcomes
basis.escalation_rate: two of six calibration tasks meet the frozen retrospective escalation rule
basis.local_first_log_odds: zero is the design alternative for a non-inferiority study; it is not an estimated effect
basis.variance_components: retained conservative protocol assumptions because one task per repository cannot identify repository and task variance separately
